correctness.rationale: The Fano axioms reduce P3 convexity to unique join-line and meet-point closure. Partition of point subsets into the seven exhaustive types yields exactly the displayed bivariate polynomial. Quadrangles rule out four-cap and 5/6-point cases, and the maximum proper antichain is exactly 21 line-pencil plus 28 line-outside-point classes. The independent verifier scans all 2^14 subsets and verifies both closure criteria, all coefficients and maximal classes; no infinite extrapolation is claimed.

value.rationale: The Fano Levi/Heawood graph is the canonical smallest order-2 projective incidence example and unique cubic girth-six cage. The explicit two-variable convexity polynomial and complete nonpure maximal-closed-set classification (21 size-six and 28 size-eight sets, gap at sizes 7 and 9–13) give a motivated exact structural benchmark for the 2026 counting problem, rather than a routine count chosen from arbitrary graphs. The result makes no unjustified larger-family promise.
